title: Clock machine setup
statement: Let $K$ and $W$ be finite Boolean Turing machines. If $K$ halts on Boolean input $x$ with output word $s$ after exactly $t_K$ steps, then there are a natural number $a$ and choices of contents and head positions for the $K$ work tapes such that $a\le t_K+|s|+|x|+5$, and after $a$ steps the clock machine started on $x$ is in its decrement state with $W$'s initial configuration on $x$, buffer tape containing $s$ with its head at position $0$, and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: $K$ halts on $x$ with output $s$ after exactly $t_K$ steps
